ac_results.ac: stdout and stderr carry no ANSI escapes and the CLI never reads stdin (TS-INV-03) (covers: REQ-25)
ac_results.evidence: BUG-1 fixed: bin/envlint.mjs adds visible() which prints C0/DEL/C1 control chars as literal \xHH, applied at the stdout print site and both stderr print sites. New test 'TS-INV-03: ESC in an env value, env key or schema key never reaches the output raw' (ESC in value, env key -> PARSE_BAD_KEY line, schema key -> missing-key line) asserts 3 stdout lines, no raw control bytes, and literal '\x1b[31mred'. node --test test/cli.test.mjs test/cli-edges.test.mjs -> 13/13 pass; harness verify t0 cli --round 2 --attempt 1 -> green 2/2

assumptions: Control characters are rendered as a literal \xHH escape (e.g. ESC -> \x1b); the spec fixes no escape format, only that no ANSI escape reaches the output.
The whole C0 range (including TAB), DEL and C1 are escaped, not only ESC, since C1 0x9b (CSI) is an ANSI introducer too and the fix hint names C0/C1.
deviations: Sanitization was also applied to the stderr print sites (fail() and the unexpected-error catch), which the BUG-1 'actual' does not cite; the AC names stderr too, and env/schema paths from argv reach stderr, so it is the same defect at the sibling print site. Only the TS-INV-03 AC is reported because operation is fix; other ACs were not touched.
